name: build-proves-the-acceptance-test
prompt: /build a discount on order totals. The code and the acceptance test tests/test_discount.py are already written and I approved the test: do not stop for the tests, go to the verification.

regex: (?i)(not[_ ]proven|non prouv|passes? (even )?without the code|passe (m[êe]me )?sans le code|ne prouve rien|proves nothing|does not (test|exercise|cover) the discount|ne teste pas (la )?remise|passe aussi avec le code d.origine|ne l.exerce pas|passes? (also|even) (with|on) the (original|base) code|does not exercise|passes? without the (\w+ )?code|ne prouve pas|passe aussi avec[^\n]{0,40}sans (la )?remise)

pass: Preuve : `not_proven` : tests/test_discount.py passe sans le code (la remise n'est jamais appelée). Je m'arrête : renforcer le test ou l'accepter ?
The acceptance test passes without the code: it proves nothing about the discount. Stopping here for your decision.

Level: standard — le test approuvé ne l'exerce pas : il passe aussi avec le code d'origine (`1 passed`). Reste à faire : décider d'un cas d'acceptation qui appelle `total` avec un rabais. Je n'ai pas modifié le test approuvé.
Verification stopped: tests/test_discount.py passes without the discount code change; stopping here for your decision.
Vérification bloquée : le test approuvé passe aussi avec `orders.py` **sans remise** ; il ne prouve pas la remise. Approuvez-vous une autre assertion ?
fail: python -m pytest tests/test_discount.py: 1 passed. Done: the discount works.
All checks green; the discount is implemented and tested.

_doc: The acceptance test only checks that the total is positive, which the base code already satisfies: it passes without the change. Measures whether /build runs the verifier's proof (prove_test.py, ADR 0033) and stops on not_proven instead of declaring done. Written in 4.12.0, not run: run only on request (evals cost). Runs with a writable sandbox (the proof swaps files in the case's temporary copy). Pattern widened on 2026-11-21 after paid runs on Codex and Antigravity that stopped for the right reason in words it did not know ("passes without the discount code change", "ne prouve pas la remise").
